prompt: Write a generic container Box<T> with a static factory Box.of(value), then add two generic static helpers in BoxUtils: maxOf, which needs a bounded type parameter to compare values, and unwrap, which does not.
explanation: Box<T> is a generic CLASS: the type parameter is declared on the class, so each instance is fixed to one T and get() can return T with no cast. Box.of is a generic METHOD, which is why it needs its own <T> before the return type -- static members cannot see the class's type parameter. In BoxUtils, unwrap works for any T because it only moves values around, but maxOf calls compareTo, so it must bound its parameter with <T extends Comparable<T>> to promise the compiler that T has that method. Starting maxOf with an empty box makes the "nothing to compare" case fall out for free.
hints: Declare the field as `private T value;`. isEmpty() is just `return value == null;`, which is what makes set(null) empty the box again.
A static generic factory needs its own type parameter: `public static <T> Box<T> of(T value)`. Inside, create a new Box<T>, set the value, and return it.
In maxOf, keep the answer in a `Box<T> best = new Box<T>();` and skip any input box that isEmpty(). Replace best when it is still empty, or when box.get().compareTo(best.get()) > 0.
